urls.rationale: Article 3 (Lobbyists) is the lobbying-disclosure regime: registration, reporting, prohibitions.
Article 1 provides chapter-wide definitions and short-title/legislative-purpose provisions used by Article 3.
Article 2 creates the West Virginia Ethics Commission and provides the enforcement scaffolding (powers, duties, complaint processing, penalties) for the Article 3 lobbying regime.

notes: Tree depth is 4 (chapter06b TOC lists article-level URLs as leaves, requiring pass-3 to descend to section-level). Article 2A (Rules) is excluded — it contains procedural rule-making bookkeeping, not statutory provisions cross-referenced from the lobbying regime.
